user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surfaces websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates safety and relevance of landing pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content to train OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Executes user-initiated web requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions and GPT Actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Enhances utility and safety of generative AI models by collecting training content.
user_agents.scope: Public web content that could potentially contribute to AI model training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user-initiated questions in Claude AI.
user_agents.scope: Sites accessed through user-initiated requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information to build Google search indexes and other product crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and related search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features displaying images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls videos for video-related search features and products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible content across Google teams.
user_agents.scope: Internal research, development, and various Google product team crawls.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs fetched for general Google product team needs.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs fetched for general Google product team needs.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawls requested by site owners.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models for Gemini Apps/Vertex AI and prompt grounding.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet for search.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet for search.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search across Apple products and collects data for generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across websites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt, or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls usage of crawled content for training Apple's generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl; determines how data crawled by Applebot is used.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to gather, cache, and display preview information.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models and improving products via indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to provide accurate customer information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use noarchive/noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt or use noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live information from the web to respond to user queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated live fetching; does not crawl content for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler providing open data copy of the internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of web pages across domain names.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent CCBot or join opt-out registry.
